articles.title: Crypto's Sisyphean struggle
articles.snippet: Progress will effectively reset when the new Congress is sworn in, because key senators who quarterbacked the bill will not be on the ballot again, writes the Cato Institute's Ryan Chan-Wei.

articles.title: BlackRock offers a glimpse of how tokenization may change your investment portfolio
articles.snippet: Tokenization is not just about putting individual stocks and funds onchain. The next step could be entire investment portfolios that can be traded, rebalanced and eventually managed in real-time.

articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin reverses big early gains following soft U.S. jobs data
articles.snippet: Bond yields also suffered a major whipsaw, turning higher by the afternoon after early declines.

articles.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin after more than a decade
articles.snippet: A Tether-backed project, Utexo, plans to support private USDT transfers, direct swaps between BTC and USDT and loans backed by BTC, while keeping most transaction data off Bitcoin’s public ledger.
